checks.name: same nonlinear learned architecture constructive witness
arrangement recurrence and attainable region count
checks.interpretation: Adding a plane splits at most as many existing regions as the prior planes form on that plane. This yields R(n,d)<=R(n-1,d)+R(n-1,d-1), with R(0,d)=R(n,0)=1. Pascal recurrence gives the binomial-sum bound. Strict patterns are convex intersections of open halfspaces. Margin excludes boundary ties. This is not a proof that observed14 is optimal for the encoder/training system.
